author: Sophia
title: Elon Musk creates a studio game to develop AI-mig
text:
Elon Musk has announced the establishment of a new -based game studio. According to him, the studio will develop games with artificial intelligence (AI) and everyone can join the group.
So far, there are a few details about the project. However, in the process of performing the capabilities of the new Grok 3-AI-chattot XII-IT has been shown that it can create simple games, for example, the Tetris version in Python. In addition, there is an example of how Grok 3 creates a similar game of a bubble game with physics and basic clashes.
Musk notes that the XII studio is working on the integration of optical graphics in AI-Gigra. He also mentioned that Grok can improve the graphic resolution on demand, but it is still unclear whether this technology will only be applied in games created by Grok or it will become a unique function. Similar to NVIDIA DLSS.
Currently, only nine people in the XII studio, including the mask. It is still unclear whether the group may develop complex projects, but, evaluated by the first experiments, XII bet on creating games created by AI.
